description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the LeaveEntitlementDao component of the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for querying, saving, updating, and deleting leave entitlement data, including data retrieval with filters, and the handling of leave entitlements within the leave management system.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LeaveEntitlementDao data access layer of the Leave module in OrangeHRM, covering retrieval, creation, update, deletion, and report generation of leave entitlement data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, creating a new DAO instance, setting up fixtures, and preparing mock services.

methods.name: getFixturePath
methods.description: Returns the path to the fixture YAML file containing test data.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveEntitlementsWithNoFilters
methods.description: Tests retrieval of leave entitlements with no filters applied, checks total count and sum.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveEntitlementsSorting
methods.description: Verifies sorting functionality by leave type name in descending order.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveEntitlementsWithAllFilters
methods.description: Tests filtered search with employee number, leave type, and date range; checks count and sum.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveEntitlementsWithEmpNumbers
methods.description: Tests filtering by multiple employee numbers, including edge cases with non-existing or deleted employees.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveEntitlementsByLeaveType
methods.description: Tests filtering entitlements by specific leave type IDs, including no matches.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveEntitlementsByEmpNumber
methods.description: Tests filtering entitlements for specific employees, including multiple and non-existing employees.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveEntitlementsByDates
methods.description: Tests filtering by date ranges, verifying correct date-based retrieval.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlement
methods.description: Tests fetching a single leave entitlement by ID, including non-existing ID.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveEntitlementNew
methods.description: Tests creating a new leave entitlement record and verifying persistence.

methods.name: testGetValidLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of valid leave entitlements within specified date ranges and conditions.

methods.name: testGetValidLeaveEntitlementsMultipleLeavePeriods
methods.description: Tests handling of leave entitlement periods spanning multiple date ranges.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveEntitlementUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing leave entitlement record.

methods.name: testDeleteLeaveEntitlementsMultiple
methods.description: Checks deletion of multiple leave entitlements and verification of their 'deleted' status.

methods.name: testMatchingEntitlementsNoMatches
methods.description: Tests retrieval when no matching entitlements are found.

methods.name: testMatchingEntitlementsVerifyNoPartialMatches
methods.description: Verifies that only exact range matches are returned, no partial overlaps.

methods.name: testMatchingEntitlementsOneMatch
methods.description: Checks that a single matching entitlement is correctly retrieved.

methods.name: testMatchingEntitlementsDoesNotMatchDeleted
methods.description: Ensures deleted entitlements are excluded from matching results.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementsByIds
methods.description: Tests retrieval of leave entitlements by a list of IDs, handling non-existent IDs.

methods.name: _compareEntitlements
methods.description: Helper to compare expected and actual LeaveEntitlement objects.

methods.name: _compareEntitlement
methods.description: Helper to compare individual LeaveEntitlement objects for equality.

methods.name: _verifyDeletedFlags
methods.description: Verifies the 'deleted' status of entitlements based on provided IDs.

methods.name: testBulkAssignLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Tests bulk assignment of leave entitlements to multiple employees.

methods.name: xtestBulkAssignLeaveEntitlementsLinkingOfUnlinkedLeave
methods.description: Placeholder for linking unlinked leave entitlements, currently disabled.

methods.name: testGetEntitlementUsageForLeave
methods.description: Tests retrieval of entitlement usage details for a particular leave ID.

methods.name: dataProviderForGetEntitlementUsageForLeave
methods.description: Data provider supplying test cases for entitlement usage retrieval.

methods.name: testGetLeaveWithoutEntitlements
methods.description: Tests fetching leaves without entitlements within date ranges for employees.

methods.name: dataProviderForGetLeaveWithoutEntitlements
methods.description: Data provider for leave without entitlements test cases.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypesForEntitlementUsageReport
methods.description: Tests retrieval of leave types for entitlement usage reports based on filters.

methods.name: testGetEmployeesForEntitlementUsageReportForPastEmployees
methods.description: Tests employee list retrieval for entitlement usage report with 'onlyPast' filter.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeIdsForEntitlementsByEmployee
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of leave type IDs for a given employee, including non-existing employees.
